Name: Run-WordCount-Complete
Args:
set -euo pipefail

echo "=== DOWNLOAD DO JAR ==="
aws s3 cp s3://650379606721-emr-lab-wordcount/jars/wordcount.jar /tmp/wordcount.jar

echo "=== LIMPEZA DOS CAMINHOS ANTERIORES ==="
hdfs dfs -rm -r -f hdfs:///input || true
hdfs dfs -rm -r -f hdfs:///output/wordcount || true
rm -rf /tmp/wordcount-output /tmp/jarcheck

echo "=== COPIA S3 PARA HDFS ==="
s3-dist-cp --src s3://650379606721-emr-lab-wordcount/input/ --dest hdfs:///input/

echo "=== VERIFICACAO DO JAR ==="
mkdir -p /tmp/jarcheck
cd /tmp/jarcheck
jar xf /tmp/wordcount.jar META-INF/MANIFEST.MF || true

echo "=== EXECUCAO DO WORDCOUNT ==="
if [ -f META-INF/MANIFEST.MF ] && grep -q '^Main-Class:' META-INF/MANIFEST.MF; then
  hadoop jar /tmp/wordcount.jar hdfs:///input/ hdfs:///output/wordcount/
else
  hadoop jar /tmp/wordcount.jar WordCountApplication hdfs:///input/ hdfs:///output/wordcount/
fi

echo "=== RESULTADO NO HDFS ==="
hdfs dfs -ls hdfs:///output/wordcount/
hdfs dfs -cat hdfs:///output/wordcount/part-r-00000 | head -20

echo "=== COPIA HDFS PARA S3 ==="
hdfs dfs -copyToLocal hdfs:///output/wordcount/ /tmp/wordcount-output
aws s3 rm s3://650379606721-emr-lab-wordcount/output/ --recursive || true
aws s3 cp /tmp/wordcount-output/ s3://650379606721-emr-lab-wordcount/output/ --recursive

echo "=== PROCESSAMENTO CONCLUIDO ==="
